text:
emma: FYI Solaris partner flagged discrepancies vs marketplace billing after we enabled SKU multiplexing. Looks like session-fragmentation + alias-merging issue. Need short plan for mapping their sub-SKUs -> single entitlement and recon.

raj: Quick context: Solaris devices emit per-second micro-pulses. Their aggregator emits two parallel minute streams: "usage_main" and "usage_aux". We map both to marketplace SKU 'solaris-standard-hour' but one stream should be discounted by 0.5x (seat multiplier). Our adapter currently sums both equally -> ~7% over-reporting.

claire: Also saw fragmentation: firmware batches at irregular boundaries so single session can split across multiple minute buckets with overlapping timestamps. Without a canonical usage_key we get duplicates on retry.

solaris-bot: sample partner minute payload (anonymized):
```json
{"device":"sl-42","minute_start":"2026-07-10T14:12:00Z","stream":"usage_aux","count":45,"stream_seq":1234}
```
Alternate stream_example: stream:"usage_main" count:90 seq:4321

devops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-2001 solaris-entitlement-drift

emma: Proposed fixes (short-term):
- adapter must accept explicit "stream" + "sku_alias" and "multiplier" attributes from partner mapping config
- canonical usage_key = sha256(partner_id + device + minute_epoch + stream) to dedupe at stream granularity
- for session fragments: accept optional session_id + start_ts + end_ts when available and prefer session-level coalescing before minute->hour rollup

raj: For partners who can't send session_id, fallback algo: collapse contiguous minute buckets where device reports overlapping timestamps within 2s into a single session fragment, compute fractional hours per fragment, and emit distinct usage_keys for each fragment. This allows idempotent correction if partner replays.

claire: Reconciliation plan: daily job at 00:10 UTC comparing partner-declared effective-hours (taking multiplier into account) vs invoiceable hours. New metric: effective_delta_pct = (partner_effective - marketplace_billed)/marketplace_billed. Thresholds: auto-adjust <=0.7%, bill-review 0.7%-3%, escalate >3%. For multipliers, compare both raw counts and multiplier-applied totals.

emma: Backfill: Solaris will provide 14d minute archives in s3://solaris-partners/archives/2026-07-*.json. We'll dry-run: transform both streams using updated multipliers -> compute diff CSV per-customer -> pilot adjustments for three customers.

raj: Adapter batch example (draft):
```json
{"usage_batch":[
  {"usage_key":"sha256(...)","sku":"solaris-standard-hour","qty":"0.01666667","window_start":"2026-07-10T14:12:00Z","stream":"usage_aux","multiplier":"0.5"},
  {"usage_key":"sha256(...)","sku":"solaris-standard-hour","qty":"0.03333333","window_start":"2026-07-10T14:12:00Z","stream":"usage_main","multiplier":"1.0"}
],"signature":"base64sig"}
```
Notes: qty in hours, multiplier applied at ingestion to compute effective qty. Store both raw_qty and effective_qty in ledger.

claire: Security & dedupe: require X-Partner-Sig header. Ingest will upsert by usage_key and track a trace_id. Keep a short rolling index (TTL 72h) for usage_key -> ingest_meta for quick dedupe. For backfills use a separate dry-run flag to avoid double-applying.

emma: Action owners + ETA:
- raj: adapter multiplier support + stream field + usage_key change (ETA 48h)
- claire: reconcile job & dashboard panels + delta alerts (ETA 72h)
- emma: partner comms + backfill plan + schedule sync (ETA 24h)

raj: I'll include tests for stream-merge, multiplier application, overlap-collapsing (2s tolerance), and idempotent upsert. Use decimal arithmetic for sums.

claire: Dashboard: per-partner effective_delta_pct, top SKUs by delta, recent auto-adjustments list, and a fragment-collision heatmap (minute_of_hour vs collisions).

emma: Draft customer note for legal review: "Redwood and Solaris aligned on a metering mapping issue where auxiliary streams were not applied with the agreed multiplier. Verified adjustments will be applied in the next billing cycle after partner archives are reconciled. If you received an invoice you believe is incorrect, contact billing@redwood.ai."

solaris-bot: Confirmed: Solaris will add stream->multiplier mapping to partner config and upload archives by EOD.

devops-bot: Pager rule: page partner-ingest-ops if effective_delta_pct > 3% for >30m or duplicate_key_rate > 500/min for >10m.

emma: I'll host a sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to walk mapping changes and pilot plan. Please bring adapter PRs and a sample diff CSV. Thanks team.
